nodes.name: Schedule (weekdays 08:00 ET)
nodes.notes: Fires Mon-Fri at 08:00 ET. Set n8n instance timezone to America/New_York or adjust cron to UTC equivalent.

nodes.name: LinkedIn — share post
nodes.notes: Requires LinkedIn OAuth2 credential with w_member_social scope. For Company Page posts, the LinkedIn app needs Marketing Developer Platform approval. Personal profile posting works with default app approval (5-10 min).

nodes.name: Twitter/X — post thread
nodes.notes: For real threading, replace with multiple sequential Tweet nodes chained via in_reply_to_status_id. This single-node version posts the whole thread as one tweet (truncated).

parameters.text: ✓ Published to social: *{{ $('Pick today\'s post').first().json.title }}*\n→ {{ $('Pick today\'s post').first().json.blog_url }}

nodes.notes: Optional. Drop this node if you don't want a Slack ping.
